original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹军方逮捕一名联合国工作人员遇害案嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹外交部称，南苏丹军方已就一名联合国工作人员在瓦乌镇遇害一案逮捕一名嫌疑人。遇害者Bol Rhoch Mayol Kuol是联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）的语言助理，据称于12月15日在西加扎勒河州被拘留期间死亡。外交部谴责这起罪行，并称正采取果断措施将责任人绳之以法；UNMISS亦对事件表示谴责。

location.raw_text: the town of Wau, Western Bahr el Ghazal State

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹军方已逮捕一名与联合国工作人员遇害案有关的嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Sudan’s army has arrested a suspect in connection with the killing of a United Nations staff member in the town of Wau last week, the foreign ministry said on Saturday.

key_facts.fact: 遇害者为联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）语言助理Bol Rhoch Mayol Kuol
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bol Rhoch Mayol Kuol, a language assistant with the U.N. Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS), was killed on Dec. 15 while in detention in Western Bahr el Ghazal State

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹外交部谴责该事件并称正采取果断措施追究责任
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The government said it was taking “decisive steps” to ensure those responsible are brought to justice

key_facts.fact: UNMISS谴责其工作人员在瓦乌被拘留期间遇害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: UNMISS said on Friday it condemned the killing of its staff member while in detention in Wau.

key_facts.fact: 瓦乌当地消息人士称Kuol在联合国巡逻期间被SSPDF士兵拘留并带至军事基地后死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sources in Wau told Radio Tamazuj that Kuol, a South Sudanese national, was detained by SSPDF soldiers during a U.N. patrol in the Masna Talib area, south of Wau town, and was taken to a military base, where he later died.

uncertainties: 嫌疑人身份及遇害具体情节尚未公布
Kuol被拘留及死亡经过目前仅依据瓦乌当地消息人士说法，尚未获独立证实
事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
